janaf_printed.identity: Effective S7 stoichiometry in a sulfur-vapor equilibrium model; no resolved isomer ensemble.
janaf_printed.thermal_construction: Estimated vibrational heat capacity per vibrational degree of freedom from S/S2/S8; third-law energy fit to sulfur-vapor measurements.

jackson2016.method: Global search and calibrated harmonic individual-gas thermodynamics, with an S8 energy reference; mixture chemical potential is a separate equilibrium result.
jackson2016.identity: Cs ring and compact branched Cs alternative; the mentioned 1 eV early-search advantage is not a final ring/branched energy gap.

fedyaeva2023.scope: USPEX/PBE search and B3LYP/6-311+G(d,p) refinement; ozone-like S3 and closed helical rings for stable n>=5. Finite-temperature calculations stop at 1500 K. S7 second-composition free-energy difference becomes positive above about 900 K; this is not a formation-energy anchor.

rau1973.access: primary abstract and JANAF attribution; original complete text not obtained
rau1973.scope: Sulfur vapor measurements at 823-1273 K, not independent verification throughout 1500-4000 K.
